videos.description:
【urban legend】SLENDER MAN / スレンダーマン
Slender Man is an internet urban legend that originated in 2009 on the American forum "Something Awful" during a horror image contest. Created by user Eric Knudsen (under the pseudonym Victor Surge), the initial manipulated photographs depicted a tall, thin humanoid figure in a black suit with a featureless white face, standing ominously behind groups of children. These images formed the foundation for what would become the Slender Man mythos.
The character rapidly spread through internet culture and became a staple of Creepypasta (online horror stories). Slender Man is typically portrayed as a silent, spectral entity that causes paranoia, hallucinations, and psychological distress in his victims. He is often said to target children specifically, luring them into the woods or compelling them to act against their will. His lack of clear motives and eerie stillness contribute significantly to the fear he evokes.
In 2014, Slender Man gained international notoriety when two 12-year-old girls in Wisconsin stabbed a classmate, claiming they acted under his influence. The incident marked a chilling moment when an internet myth crossed into real-world violence, prompting media scrutiny and public concern. Since then, Slender Man has transcended meme status to become a subject of academic inquiry in media studies, psychology, and digital folklore.
As a modern "digital myth," Slender Man exemplifies how online spaces can foster collective imagination and transform abstract fears into shared narratives. He remains a powerful symbol of how the internet can blur the boundaries between fiction and reality.

スレンダーマン（Slender Man）は、2009年にアメリカの掲示板サイト「Something Awful」で行われたホラー画像コンテストをきっかけに誕生したインターネット都市伝説である。ユーザーのエリック・クヌーゼン（Victor Surge）が投稿した加工写真には、細長い手足と無表情な白い顔を持つ黒服の人型が子どもたちの背後に立っており、これがスレンダーマンとして知られる存在の原型となった。
このキャラクターは急速にネット文化の中で拡散し、Creepypasta（インターネット怪談）の定番として定着した。スレンダーマンは言葉を話さず、物音も立てずに現れ、人間の心理に作用して錯乱や幻覚を引き起こすとされる。また、特に子どもをターゲットにするという設定が多く、誘拐や洗脳といったモチーフも含まれる。その不明瞭な動機と姿勢が、恐怖をかき立てる大きな要因となっている。
2014年には、ウィスコンシン州でスレンダーマンの存在を信じた12歳の少女たちが、同級生を刺傷する事件が発生。都市伝説が現実の暴力事件へと波及した衝撃的な事例として、社会的関心を集めた。以降、スレンダーマンは単なるネットミームの枠を超え、メディア研究や心理学、デジタルフォークロア（現代の民間伝承）における重要な研究対象とされている。
スレンダーマンは現代における「デジタル神話」とも言え、ネットがいかにして共同幻想を生み出し、人々の恐怖を形にするのかを示す象徴的存在である。

videos.author: @cutiebabooby
videos.description:
Crazy I remember watching this vid I was 12 years old, I was so scared he was real!
In 2014, two 12-year-old girls in Wisconsin lured their classmate, Payton Leutner, into the woods. They attacked her and stabbed her 19 times, leaving her there.

Why?

They believed the fictional internet character Slenderman was real and that killing Payton would prove their loyalty to him and protect their families from him.

Against all odds, Payton survived. She managed to crawl toward a nearby road, where a passing bicyclist found her and called for help.

Slenderman was never real. But the fear and belief surrounding him led to a very real crime.

The case became known as the Slender Man stabbing.
